title: Dynamic dual-input rank certificate (build-only, no brain.run())
premise_under_test: The V1 perturbation operator is RANK-2: every anesthetic/genotype profile collapses to two scalars (total_pa, broadcast IDENTICALLY to all N neurons into I_ext; and snare_gain, SNARE's lone global multiplicative synaptic weight scale). Forward map QF = G(total_pa, snare_gain).

method.no_brain_run: brain.run() MUST NOT be called. Only the brain constructor + apply_genotype + apply_anesthetic are invoked, with I_ext and synapse weights snapshotted before/after.
method.factory: worm SeededLIFBrain (use_per_edge_glu_signs=True); rank gates evaluated on the worm operator, which is the canonical run_single default. Fly/mouse share the identical apply_genotype/apply_anesthetic code path (verified by import in P18-A scope).

matrices.D: cases x N_neurons matrix of per-case I_ext deltas (post-pre, in pA), restricted to non-trivial (nonzero) current-axis cases
matrices.S: cases x N_synapses matrix of per-case synapse-weight RATIOS (post/pre), restricted to non-trivial (ratio != 1) SNARE/wsyn cases

statistics.singular_spectrum: SVD of D and of S; count singular values > tau
statistics.rho_k: per-case spatial-uniformity residual of each I_ext delta row d_k: rho_k = || d_k - mean(d_k)*ones || / (||d_k|| + eps). rho_k=0 => perfect all-ones broadcast.
statistics.synapse_uniformity: per-case synapse ratio uniformity r_k: max(|ratio_i - median(ratio)|) over synapses; 0 => single global scalar

decision_rule.>1e-6: FALSIFY (hidden per-neuron/synapse structure => rank>2 => FAIL => HALT build program)

G1-current-rank.criterion: number of singular values of D exceeding tau (1e-6) EQUALS 1, AND max_k rho_k < 1e-6 (every I_ext delta is a spatially-uniform all-ones broadcast).
G1-current-rank.fail_meaning: more than one nonzero singular value OR any non-uniform delta => hidden per-neuron structure => current operator rank>1 in space => rank-2 premise FALSE => HALT.

G2-synapse-rank.criterion: S is rank-1 (number of singular values of S exceeding tau EQUALS 1) AND every per-case synapse ratio is spatially uniform (max r_k < 1e-6 => single global SNARE/wsyn scalar).
G2-synapse-rank.fail_meaning: per-synapse-varying scale => SNARE axis is not a single global scalar => rank>2 => HALT.

G3-coverage-completeness.criterion: 7/7 current-axis mechanism classes exercised, 4/4 genotype branches exercised, and 100% of the load-bearing if-branches inside apply_anesthetic + apply_genotype actually exercised at least once. If incomplete, the rank gates G1/G2 are VOID.
G3-coverage-completeness.fail_meaning: battery did not exercise the operator fully => rank certificate is not coverage-complete => VOID.

overall_pass_rule: G1-current-rank PASS AND G2-synapse-rank PASS AND G3-coverage-completeness PASS. ANY gate FAIL => block FAIL => HALT the WF2 build program (re-scope ledger). G3 FAIL => rank gates VOID (indeterminate).
anti_target_engineering: tau frozen at 1e-6 from roadmap line 152/154 BEFORE any run. No threshold is tuned to outcome. A FAIL is reported loudly and is a pre-accepted, real outcome that HALTS the build program.
